categories.bug: precedence: operator precedence around ?: produced the wrong value
categories.bug: wrong branch: the branches were swapped or the condition inverted
categories.bug: missing default: the final branch gave the wrong value for an unhandled case
categories.bug: evaluation: a branch ran when it shouldn't, or evaluation order mattered
categories.fix: ternary extended: a bug fix that added a branch to a ternary; the construct wasn't the cause
categories.fix: other code in a ternary: the faulty value sat in a ternary branch; the construct wasn't the cause
categories.refactor: to ternary: if/else or other code rewritten as a ternary
categories.refactor: from ternary: a ternary removed or rewritten as other code
categories.readability: parenthesised: parentheses added for readability, no behaviour change claimed
categories.lint policy: a lint or formatter setting about ternaries
categories.tooling: ternaries in analysed code: the project's own tooling parses or highlights ternaries in other code
categories.unrelated: the keyword means something else (config precedence, a data structure, TypeScript optional properties)
